hero.headline: Open Source Contributor & Full-Stack Developer
hero.subhead: Core Contributor @ Elixpo · GSSoC 2026 Contributor · CSE Undergrad
hero.intro: Hi, I am Bhumika Sudarshani. Turning ideas into code, and code into impact. Comfortable presenting technical work to non-technical audiences and collaborating in fast-paced, cross-functional team settings. Open Source Contributor, Full-Stack Development, and everything in between.

intro.description: I turn real-world problems into working data-driven products — across frontend, backend, APIs, and applied AI.

websiteSection.designedBy: Huge shoutout to the Elixpo core team and community — being part of building multiple Elixpo products alongside them has shaped how I think about shipping real, collaborative open-source work.
websiteSection.futurePlans: I want to go deeper into applied AI for accessibility and go further with data-driven products — building dashboards, trackers, and tools that turn messy real-world data into something people can actually use and trust.
websiteSection.codeStory: My journey started with wanting to make technology more accessible. That led to VAANI, a real-time sign-language-to-speech tool combining computer vision with natural-language generation. Alongside that, contributing as a core member at Elixpo — working across products like accounts.elixpo, blogs.elixpo, sketch.elixpo, opensource.elixpo, and payouts.elixpo — and as a GSSoC 2026 contributor on NexaSphere, pushed me to build full-stack data products (Financial-Log) and dashboards (CampusPulse), taking ideas from requirements through to deployment-ready products.
